BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The expensive request handler is reachable over the network.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Sending many requests needs no special conditions.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The attacker needs no account to send the requests.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact stays within the vulnerable application and its resources.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: A flood of requests to the expensive handler can make the application unresponsive or crash it.
